task.title: Docs: write down the shipping rule
task.body: Document the CURRENT shipping implementation in docs/SHIPPING.md; do not fix behavior.

rationale: At exactly 5000 cents the code charges 599; the new doc promises free shipping.

task.title: SAVE10 should take ten percent off
task.body: Fix SAVE10 so a 3950-cent subtotal gets a 395-cent discount. Keep fixed coupons working.

rationale: Changing SAVE10 to fixed takes only ten cents, not ten percent.

task.title: Count quantities, not cart rows
task.body: itemCount must sum quantities and return zero for an empty cart.

rationale: The new reducer starts at one, so every result is one too high.

task.title: Free shipping starts at exactly $50
task.body: Fix the boundary and add a regression test that fails on base and passes on head.

rationale: The implementation is correct, but the added 8000-cent test already passes on base.

task.title: Zero-pad receipt cents
task.body: Only fix formatCents padding and add its regression test. Do not change shipping policy.

rationale: The padding fix also changes unrelated shipping from 599 to 999 cents.

task.title: Free shipping starts at exactly $50
task.body: Ship free at >=5000 cents, retain the 599-cent charge below the threshold and free empty carts.

rationale: Replacing shipping with zero also makes small orders ship free.

task.title: Zero-pad receipt cents
task.body: Show 105 cents as $1.05, preserving signs and other amounts.

rationale: padEnd turns five cents into fifty cents.

task.title: Round percentage discounts to the nearest cent
task.body: Percent coupons must use Math.round to the nearest cent. Fixed coupons keep their clamp.

rationale: Math.floor loses a cent for a 15-cent subtotal at ten percent.

task.title: Fix percent discounts, preserve fixed coupon caps
task.body: Use rounded percent arithmetic; no coupon may discount more than the subtotal.

rationale: The percent fix removes the fixed-coupon cap and over-discounts small carts.
